role: paired development ablation of the two frozen V4 reserve components
registration_context: complete V3 and V4 outcomes known; inventory-only and power-only outcomes unobserved
unchanged_contract: inherit V3 asset, per-unit capacity, efficiency, common initial stocks, forecast calibration, integer profiles, receipt priority, lead time, physical execution, failure event, prices and terminal accounting

roster.development_samples: all original April, July and October 2024 ten-day samples
roster.paired_baseline: saved V3 rows for identical profile, sample and window

control.lookback_basis: existing 60-minute nomination lead plus 30-minute delivery slot; one fixed rule, no parameter sweep
control.history_visibility: only instruction flows executed in [decision-90min, decision), reconstructed with the original receipt-time priority; later receipts never enter an earlier decision
control.history_bootstrap: use the already cached one-day instruction prefix; this supplies observed history, not a different simulated initial stock
control.energy_reserve: for each unit, L = past BOA gross export / discharge_efficiency; R = charge_efficiency * past BOA gross import; integrate ramps and zero crossings exactly, with zero contribution when no BOA is active
control.target: retain V3 profile fraction times unit capacity
control.reserve_conflict: if the empirical interval is empty, report a reserve-rule conflict and HOLD this development gate; do not relabel it as physical infeasibility or alter the lookback, asset, workload or threshold
control.power_reserve: retain V4 observed opposite-unit peak bound, received-future headroom and joint nomination bound
control.power_reserve_basis: observed workload preparation, not a historical unit hardware rating
control.nomination: retain V3 projection of each stock, the two fixed pending nominations and received BOAs over 90 minutes; substitute the reserve-mapped target and additional observed power bound
control.execution: retain unchanged V3 physical execution and stop at the first actual inventory or shared-power failure

validation: analytical tests of reserve energy, opposite-unit power headroom and unchanged queue timing
a future unreceived BOA must not alter any earlier reserve or nomination
evaluate the full frozen roster and report April, July, October and their common feasible library set
retain V3 negative results and paired failure outcomes; completed-window cost cannot rank a method that fails the feasibility gate
gate: retain the V3 95% finite-window development criterion: at least one actual library profile feasible in all three samples and at least one unsafe library profile; a gate pass alone does not authorize source comparison or establish OR readiness
limitations: post-V4 development ablation, not independent confirmation; overlapping windows and exogenous historical BOAs retain their original interpretation

component_condition.name: power_reserve_only
component_condition.target: retain V3 profile fraction times unit capacity
component_condition.power: retain V4 observed opposite-unit peak bound, received-future headroom and joint nomination bound
